name: slack-interaction
title: Slack Interaction
description: Slack: reply, post, read, upload, and the thread rules. What the engine already posts, the one-message rule, `slack-reply`, `slack-post`, `slack-start-thread`, `slack-read`, `slack-upload-file`, `slack-download-file`, `slack-list-channels`, `slack-update`, `slack-delete`, unknown-user registration with `manage-user`, and Slack standing orders. Use before any Slack message.
